events.body: The cancellation is attributed to the rider, which routes the case through NS-0 to NS-4 [F4][NS-0]. Under NS-4, an instant booking cancelled within 3 minutes of matching is free; beyond that the $6.61 fee stands [NS-4]. The recorded timeline shows acceptance at 08:40:00 and the rider's own cancellation at 08:46:40, i.e. 6 min 40 s (400 s) after acceptance, well past the 3-minute grace period, and chat #2 confirms the rider decided to cancel because plans changed [F4][F10][NS-4]. The system record (timeline/fare) therefore settles the fee: $6.61 was charged and is the published cancellation amount [F4][F7][NS-4]. Because the fee is validly imposed, the rider's request that it be struck is answered by the NS-4 rule itself, and NS-4 directs no refund and no action — the rider's fairness concern is a matter for discretionary relief, not a fee-waiver condition [F10][NS-4]. Waiting-fee and no-show logic are not in play: this is a rider-initiated cancellation, so NS-1/NS-2 (driver-claimed no-show) and NS-6 (waiting fee) do not apply; the driver's arrival facts (platform arrival at 08:41:25, driver "I'm Here" at 08:42:15 within 40 m and 4 min 25 s within 200 m afterwards) are consistent with the driver being present but are not the basis of the charge [F2][F5][F6][NS-1][NS-6]. Non-metered fixed-fare logic is unaffected by mileage or the driver's approach distance (39 m closest approach), and no ERP/toll or unpublished add-on appears on the record [F1][F7][F8][RD-2][FARE-1]. The driver profile (2 no-show disputes upheld in 90 d) cannot decide anything by itself and, since no refund is due, does not trigger RD-6's account flag [F17][RD-6]. events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked at your cancellation and the fee stands. You booked, the driver accepted, and you cancelled about six and a half minutes later. Instant bookings are free to cancel for the first 3 minutes after a driver accepts; after that the cancellation fee applies. So the $6.61 charge stays and there is no refund. If you believe it should be waived as a goodwill gesture, reply to this message and ask for a human review — a reviewer will look at your cancellation and your account history. No change is being made to your account.

DRIVER: The rider cancelled this trip themselves about six and a half minutes after you accepted, which is past the 3-minute free-cancellation window, so the $6.61 cancellation fee is valid. It is paid to you as a Ryde voucher, the same way other cancellation fees are credited to your account. Nothing is being flagged on your account over this trip. Your arrival and location during the trip were consistent with the booking, so no waiting-fee or no-show issue arises here. You do not need to do anything.
